findings.text: D1: Block-explorer direct fetches were blocked (etherscan.io, defipunkd.com allowlist). Search results surfaced 'Stargate Finance: Multisig' label at 0x65bb797c2b9830d891d87288f029ed8dacc19705 on Ethereum and 'Stargate Finance: STG Token' at 0xaf5191b0de278c7286d6c7cc6ab6bb8a73ba2cd6 on Ethereum via Etherscan search snippets. L2Beat search snippet surfaced a 3/6-threshold multisig structure on Ethereum controlling pool/messaging contracts.

D2: Official deployed-contracts page at https://stargateprotocol.gitbook.io/stargate/v2-developer-docs/technical-reference/mainnet-contracts was successfully fetched. It lists contracts for Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Metis, Linea, Mantle, Base, Kava, Scroll, Aurora, Core, Sonic, Unichain, Gnosis, Soneium, and 30+ Hydra CAs chains. Contract types per chain: FeeLibV1*, StargateMultiRewarder, StargatePoolNative/USDC/USDT/mETH/ETH, StargateStaking, TokenMessaging, Treasurer, CreditMessaging, OFTWrapper, StargateOFT*, RewardLib, RewardRegistryLib. A second docs site at https://docs.stargate.finance/resources/contracts/mainnet-contracts exists but its body was not full-fetched (only nav returned).

D3: The audit link in context (https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/Audits/blob/main/audits/OApp%26OFT-Zellic-12JUN2024.pdf) was not fetched this run (GitHub domain blocked for this file). The Gitbook security/audit page was also blocked. The GitHub repo at stargate-protocol/stargate-v2 has an 'audits' folder visible in the file tree but content could not be retrieved. Audit metadata partially derived from repo presence and gitbook sidebar listing 'Bounty' and 'Audit' pages. Recording as unknowns.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/stargate-protocol/stargate-v2 was fetched at HEAD (branch: main, 422 commits). The repo uses a monorepo/pnpm-workspace structure with a 'packages' directory. No broadcast/run-latest.json or hardhat-deploy artifacts were visible in the root; deployment artifacts likely live under packages/<subpackage>. The repo has an 'audits' folder at root level. No pinned SHA available from this fetch (GitHub hid last-commit metadata in the rendered page). GitHub subdirectory fetch was blocked.

D5: Multi-chain enumeration performed via the D2 Gitbook page which covers Ethereum (30101), BNB Chain (30102), Avalanche (30106), Polygon (30109), Arbitrum (30110), OP Mainnet (30111), Metis (30151), Linea (30183), Mantle (30181), Base (30184), Kava (30177), Scroll (30214), Aurora (30211), Core (30153), Sonic (30332), Unichain (30320), Gnosis (30145), Soneium (30340), plus Hydra CAs: Kaia, Iota, Taiko, Rari Chain, Sei, Flare, Gravity, Lightlink, Abstract, Peaq, Flow, Goat, Berachain, Rootstock, Hemi, Vana, Ink, Glue, Fuse, Superposition, Degen, Codex, Story, Apechain, TelosEVM, Plume, XDC, Nibiru. Chains listed in protocol.chains but not explicitly in the Gitbook page: xDai/Gnosis (present as 'Gnosis' endpointID 30145), Swellchain, Manta, Stable, LightLink (present as Lightlink). Swellchain, Manta, Stable not found in Gitbook contracts page — recorded in unknowns.

D6: No factory pattern identified in the Stargate V2 contract set from the docs. TokenMessaging and StargatePool contracts are directly deployed per asset per chain, not via a factory. No factory-enumeration call needed. StargateMultiRewarder may manage multiple reward streams but is not a factory for child contracts.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to all addresses in admin_addresses[]. Key roles: pool (StargatePoolNative/USDC/USDT/ETH/mETH), router (TokenMessaging, CreditMessaging), treasury (Treasurer), other (FeeLibV1*, StargateMultiRewarder, StargateStaking, OFTWrapper, RewardLib, RewardRegistryLib, StargateOFT*). Multisig at 0x65bb797c2b9830d891d87288f029ed8dacc19705 labeled 'Stargate Finance: Multisig' on Etherscan (3/6 per L2Beat snippet). STG token at 0xaf5191b0de278c7286d6c7cc6ab6bb8a73ba2cd6.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched Gitbook contracts page or Etherscan/L2Beat search snippets. The multisig address 0x65bb797c2b9830d891d87288f029ed8dacc19705 and STG token 0xaf5191b0de278c7286d6c7cc6ab6bb8a73ba2cd6 are from search snippets only (not full on-chain fetch), so they are recorded in admin_addresses with actor_class=unknown pending next-run verification.

protocol_metadata.about: Stargate V2 is a cross-chain bridge and liquidity protocol built on LayerZero V2, enabling native asset transfers (USDC, USDT, ETH, and others) across 20+ EVM chains. Users transfer assets by depositing into unified liquidity pools (StargatePool) on the source chain; an off-chain Planner allocates credits and a TokenMessaging contract routes the transaction via LayerZero. V2 introduces 'Bus' batching (up to 91% gas reduction), 'Taxi' immediate mode, 'Hydra' wrapped-OFT bridge-as-a-service for chains without native asset pools, and JIT liquidity intents. The governance token is STG, with veSTG (vote-escrowed) used for DAO voting.
